name: opc-develop
description: Fable-5-era product delivery: PTA product-truth assets, harness-adjudicated acceptance, and a slimmed brainstorm/design/build skill set

interface.shortDescription: PTA product truth and harness-adjudicated delivery for Fable-5-class models
interface.longDescription: opc-develop routes by whether a change touches product truth (PTA). Daily localized changes use lite (TDD on the change itself); throwaway code uses vibe (explicitly unverified); standard increments settle truth once in design — PD product bottom lines, TD hard-to-reverse technical decisions, and AC black-box criteria that double as the executable Oracle — then build expands AC into locked cases, proves a RED baseline, implements with a model-owned route, and lets the project Harness adjudicate PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE with evidence and a ratchet; completion ends with a real-environment Core-Case smoke projection. harness-init and harness-retrofit bootstrap or retrofit the workbench under docs/harness.zh-CN.md. Routing never uses predicted duration; ship/deploy/oncall/retro close the engineering loop.
defaultPrompt: Use $opc-develop:vibe to implement this immediately without tests; I will perform the acceptance.
Use $opc-develop:lite to handle this small request on the current branch with targeted tests and before/after evidence.
Use $opc-develop:testcase after the approved demo and PRD to show me, review, and compile the exact executable black-box cases.
Use $opc-develop:build after testcase approval to implement the approved Core-Case with runner-derived evidence.
